description: Fix median(values) for nonempty numeric lists: sort a copy; return the middle value for odd lengths or the mean of the two middle values for even lengths. Do not mutate the input.
reference_source:
def median(values):
    items = sorted(values)
    mid = len(items)//2
    return items[mid] if len(items)%2 else (items[mid-1]+items[mid])/2
